  (1 - rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) 
  * 
  on(instance) 
  group_left(node_load5, node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, node_memory_MemFree_bytes) 
  (
    node_info{instance=~"10.176.122.15[0-9]:.*"} 
    and 
    on(instance) 
    (
      node_load5 < 0.5 
      and 
      (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemFree_bytes) / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes > 0.5
    )
  )
)
